card.text: WASP-8 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Stassun et al. 2017

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-8b"
sources.quote: WASP-8b is an exoplanet orbiting the star WASP-8A in the constellation of Sculptor.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around WASP-8. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Stassun et al. 2017
sources.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 8.1587261, pl_radj 1.13, pl_bmassj 2.54

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-8b"
sources.quote: The star is similar to the Sun and forms a binary star with a red dwarf star (WASP-8B) of half the Sun's mass that orbits WASP-8A 4.5 arcseconds away.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.

dayside.title: Measured day side
dayside.summary: The day side is 938 K at secondary eclipse, measured at 8 µm. The night side is not measured.
